# Group Operator

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:GroupOperator`](gmeow-GroupOperator.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/GroupOperator>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
